ordered_diagnoses: Neurofibromatosis type 1-associated peripheral nerve sheath tumor

facts.raw_span: A 50-year-old man
known neurofibromatosis type 1
multiple cutaneous neurofibromas
no history of smoking
recurrent urinary retention and sepsis
transurethral resection of the prostate revealed fibroleiomyomatous hyperplasia
diffuse irregular polypoid thickening of the entire bladder wall without a discrete mass
bladder wall was diffusely thickened, firm, and gray–white, with near–complete loss of the detrusor muscle
diffuse bland spindle cell proliferation with comma-shaped nuclei and a collagenous matrix
dense, perivascular spindle cell proliferation with prominent cytological atypia, frequent mitoses, and an infiltrative growth pattern
tumor cells were positive for S100, p16, neurofilaments, and CD56
tumor cells were negative for pan-cytokeratin, EMA, MDM2, p63, ALK, CD117, DOG1, myogenin, desmin, and smooth muscle actin

concepts.why: The patient has known neurofibromatosis type 1 and the histologic evaluation revealed a diffuse bland spindle cell proliferation with comma-shaped nuclei and a collagenous matrix, consistent with neurofibroma.

The patient has known neurofibromatosis type 1, which increases the risk of developing MPNST, and the histologic evaluation revealed a dense, perivascular spindle cell proliferation with prominent cytological atypia, frequent mitoses, and an infiltrative growth pattern, consistent with MPNST.
The histologic evaluation revealed a diffuse bland spindle cell proliferation with comma-shaped nuclei and a collagenous matrix, which can be seen in solitary fibrous tumor.

The histologic evaluation revealed a dense, perivascular spindle cell proliferation with prominent cytological atypia, frequent mitoses, and an infiltrative growth pattern, which can be seen in inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor.

concepts.preferred_label: Neurofibromatosis type 1-associated peripheral nerve sheath tumor
concepts.why: The combination of diffuse bland spindle cell proliferation, perivascular spindle cell proliferation with cytological atypia, and positivity for S100 and neurofilaments explains the uncovered findings of fibroleiomyomatous hyperplasia, diffusely thickened bladder wall, and negative immunohistochemical stains.

rationales.F02: Neurofibromatosis type 1 is strongly associated with neurofibromas and malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumors.
rationales.F09: The presence of a diffuse bland spindle cell proliferation with comma-shaped nuclei and a collagenous matrix is suggestive of a neurofibroma.
rationales.F10: The presence of a dense, perivascular spindle cell proliferation with prominent cytological atypia, frequent mitoses, and an infiltrative growth pattern is more suggestive of a malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor than a neurofibroma.
rationales.F11: The tumor cells being positive for S100, p16, neurofilaments, and CD56 is consistent with a diagnosis of a neurofibroma or malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor.

frontier_selector.rationale: The presence of dense, perivascular spindle cell proliferation with prominent cytological atypia, frequent mitoses, and an infiltrative growth pattern, along with the tumor cells being positive for S100, p16, neurofilaments, and CD56, strongly supports the diagnosis of Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor, especially in the context of known neurofibromatosis type 1.
